key_insight: An inline optical roll-to-roll imaging setup can simultaneously measure multiple thin-film layer thicknesses and birefringence fast enough for in-production quality control.
engineering_relevance: This enables non-destructive, high-throughput inspection of transparent or semi-transparent layers in organic solar-cell manufacturing, helping tune deposition and improve product consistency.
method: Optical imaging in a roll-to-roll setup for inline material inspection
Simultaneous thickness reconstruction for free films or films on transparent substrates
Applicable to transparent/semi-transparent layers and birefringence estimation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a proof-of-concept on PEDOT and ZnO, with robust thickness measurement across 0.3 to 110 micrometers.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated on proof-of-concept materials, so broader accuracy across more complex multilayer stacks and real production variability still needs validation.
paper_title: Resolving multiple layer thicknesses and birefringence in thin films with an optical in-line Roll-to-Roll characterization setup
